title: Opinions on drummers: Ben Pollack, Krupa, Fatool, Morello
summary: He discusses Ben Pollack's brush playing, Gene Krupa's showiness, a drummer fired by Russ Morgan, and names Joe Morello best all-around.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
